lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: The lady was dressed in a blue coat and a large, funny hat.
lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: After the train had left the station, the lady opened her handbag and took out her powder compact.
lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: She then began to make up her face.
lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: 'Why are you doing that?' Sally asked.
lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: 'To make myself beautiful,' the lady answered.
lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: She put away her compact and smiled kindly.
lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: 'But you are still ugly,' Sally said.
lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: Sally was amused, but I was very embarrassed!

lessons.title: A walk through the woods
lessons.audioFile: New-Concept-English/新概念英语第1册美音（MP3+LRC）/NCE1-美音-(MP3+LRC)/143&144－A Walk Through the Woods.mp3

lines.text: I live in a very old town which is surrounded by beautiful woods.
lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: It is a famous beauty spot.
lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: On Sundays, hundreds of people come from the city to see our town and to walk through the woods.
lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: Visitors have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy.
lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: Litter baskets have been placed under the trees, but people still throw their rubbish everywhere.
lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: Last Wednesday, I went for a walk in the woods.
lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: What I saw made me very sad.
lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: I counted seven old cars and three old refrigerators.
lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: The little baskets were empty and the ground was covered with pieces of paper,
lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: cigarette ends, old tyres, empty bottles and rusty tins.
lines.speaker: 原声故事

lines.text: Among the rubbish, I found a sign which said, 'Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted!'
lines.speaker: 原声故事
